title: An Approximate Method for Modeling Plasmons on Graphene with Time- and Space-dependent Properties
summary: This paper presents approximate computational methods for modeling surface plasmon propagation on a graphene sheet with time- and space-dependent material properties. Starting from Maxwell's equations, the evolution of current density under a spatially and temporally modulated Drude weight is formulated as a partial integro-differential equation (PIDE). Assuming small-amplitude perturbations of the Drude weight, a regular perturbation expansion is developed.
